summary: User reported losing more than 220 GBP after using an alleged AI trading application called Claude Trade through Trust Wallet and later suspected the platform was fraudulent.
user_mistake: User trusted an unverified AI powered crypto trading platform and approved smart contract interactions without fully understanding the risks and fees involved.
prevention: Avoid trusting AI trading platforms promoted through unofficial channels and always research whether crypto trading apps are legitimate before connecting wallets or approving smart contracts.
